game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue knights can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue knights can use it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 5 consecutive correct decisions about wave_target to power up the squire and open the throne.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Village Green'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Village Green.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 5.
